What you pay to use your money
Fees to check cashers, prepaid cards and money order services add up.
Check cashers keep a percentage of each check they cash.
Prepaid cards can charge monthly fees, reload fees and ATM fees.
Each money order and counter bill payment has its own fee.
These fees are usually agreed to up front, so there\'s often nothing to ask a refund for. The bigger saving is avoiding them.
